name: PC-migration software
definition: Program that moves installed applications, settings and files from one computer to another.

name: Software-modelling tool
definition: Program for drawing and keeping UML or similar models of software systems, often generating code from them.

name: CAE and simulation software
definition: Program that simulates stress, flow, heat or other physics on a design before it is built.

name: Diagramming software
definition: Program for drawing flowcharts, org charts and network or floor diagrams from connected shapes.

name: Speech-recognition and dictation software
definition: Program that turns the user's speech into typed text and voice commands.

name: Screenwriting software
definition: Program that formats scripts for film, TV and stage and manages scenes and characters.

name: Show-control software
definition: Program that plays audio, video and lighting cues in order for a live show.

name: Peer-to-peer file-sharing client
definition: Program that shares and downloads files over Gnutella, eDonkey and similar networks other than BitTorrent.

name: Terminal emulator
definition: Program that shows a text terminal for a local shell, serial line or dial-up connection.

name: Survey and form software
definition: Program or hosted tool for building questionnaires and forms, collecting answers and reporting them.

name: Screen saver
definition: Program that shows animation or images on an idle screen, sold or distributed as its own product.

name: Collection-cataloguing software
definition: Program that catalogues the owner's books, media or other collections, often by barcode scan.

name: Digital-signage software
definition: Program that schedules and plays content on public screens and displays.

name: Business-intelligence software
definition: Program that joins data sources into dashboards, reports and visual analyses.

name: Workforce-management software
definition: Program for scheduling staff shifts, recording attendance and planning labour.
